# Quickler

> Quickler is a WhatsApp field compliance platform for UK trades. Engineers receive compliance questions on WhatsApp; replies and photos generate timestamped PDF reports automatically. Use cases include EICR electrical certificates, CP12 gas safety certificates, daily van safety checks, structural site inspection reports, PAT testing, RAMS and toolbox talks.

## What Quickler does

- Sends structured compliance questions to engineers on WhatsApp
- Accepts text, voice notes (auto-transcribed) and photos as replies
- Produces a formatted PDF report within 90 seconds of submission
- Flags faults on a manager dashboard with red, amber and green status
- Stores every record timestamped, against the engineer, the job and the date
- Provides an audit trail suitable for DVSA, NICEIC and Gas Safe inspection

No app to install. No login for engineers. No Twilio or Meta Business account required from the customer.

## Who it is for

- Electricians (EICRs, periodic inspection reports, minor works)
- Gas Safe registered engineers (CP12 landlord gas safety, service records)
- Structural engineers (site inspection reports)
- M&E contractors
- Van fleet operators (DVSA daily walkround checks)
- Safety inspection firms
- PAT testing firms
- Any UK trades firm with engineers submitting compliance data from site

## Pricing model

Per firm, not per engineer. Tiers: Starter £50/mo (1 engineer, 3 workflows), Team £100/mo (4 engineers, 5 workflows), Business £140/mo (12 engineers, 8 workflows), Scale £300/mo (30 engineers, 10 workflows). Pay annually for 10% off. UK Direct Debit or card. No setup fee.
